recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: fifty thousand boat names drifting in an open database
AI meeting recordings left unlocked on the public web
local GPU rigs racing cloud pennies toward a break-even horizon
a million homes emptied ahead of a storm crossing the coast
summer fog rolling through San Francisco after dark
agents spun up from a phone before sunrise

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a skiff through thick bay fog by tapping sonar pings that briefly reveal whimsical boat names as waypoints — collect names before the mist closes back in.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each ping opens a tiny clear pocket in the fog with a funny boat name to grab
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, ping cooldown shrinks, currents push you off course
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: monochrome nautical wireframe with soft fog particles

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Scrub glowing leaked meeting waveforms before they scroll off-screen — drag your thumb to redact audio bars while phantom transcripts multiply below.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying wipe-clean as transcripts dissolve under your finger
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more audio tracks stack, decoy static bars appear, scroll speed increases
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green on black with glitch artifacts

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick evacuees into matching shelter lanes before a storm wall reaches the bottom of the screen — wrong lane costs precious seconds.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: binary snap decisions in under a minute with visible storm pressure
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: storm front accelerates, mixed shelter icons stack, lanes narrow
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout evacuation map with watercolor storm gradient

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Hold to charge a bedside GPU rack, release to burst-process queued agent tasks — balance heat buildup against a sunrise shipping deadline.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: tension between overcharge meltdown and undercharge missing the dawn ship window
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: task queue grows faster, cooling fans stutter, deadline bar creeps in
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: neon isometric server rack with dawn gradient bleeding through the window
